metadata.description: Mods for Claude Code: plugins that change the interface itself.

plugins.name: next-up
plugins.description: A Claude Code mod: when Claude finishes an answer, suggests up to three next prompts from the conversation, your GitHub issues and pull requests, or your Linear issues.

plugins.name: linear-tree
plugins.description: A Claude Code mod: a Linear project as a tree and a flowchart in a side pane, with progress, search, shortcuts and markers on the issues agents are working on.
